behavior: The treatment magnet aligns the top of the main image to its native Designer scroll-margin-top. It no longer centres the image plus text/CTA assembly or changes target when that assembly exceeds the viewport. The section heading scrolls above the viewport. Services retains frame centring. Touch scrolling remains native.

designer.note: Only scroll-margin-top is new in this follow-up. The viewport-based height was already authored in Designer. Existing medium, small and tiny height overrides are preserved.

runtime: Reads the authored frame geometry and computed scroll margin. Writes only the existing scroll position/focus state; no height, padding, margin or layout styles are injected. Copy rows are no longer measured by this magnet.
motion: Uses the existing shared pace and damped spring, interruption, breakaway and reduced-motion policy. A frame taller than the available viewport below the inset stays ordinary scrolling.
